description: Transcribe audio to text with WORD-LEVEL timestamps (timestamps:'word' returns per-word start/end times — subtitle alignment, karaoke captions, cutting video to speech) or segment timestamps. Uses Mistral Transcription — high-accuracy speech recognition that handles accents, background noise, and overlapping speakers. 13 languages: en, zh, hi, es, ar, fr, pt, ru, de, ja, ko, it, nl. Pass names (the people and places spoken in the audio) to help the speech model spell them right — free, same price. Up to 500 MB / 60 minutes per file. Async — returns requestId, poll with check_job_status(jobType='transcription'), then get_job_result. 10 sats/min. Privacy: audio and transcripts are ephemeral — processed, returned, and discarded. Never persisted. Pay per request with Bitcoin Lightning — no API key or signup needed. Requires create_payment with toolName='transcribe_audio'.

callback_id.description: Optional correlation string echoed back in the webhook body. Max 128 chars.

callback_url.description: Optional HTTPS webhook we POST when the job finishes (HMAC-signed). Polling still works.

diarize.description: Identify different speakers (default false). Forces segment granularity upstream. If the speaker-label request fails, you still get the text, and result.degraded includes 'diarization'.

names.description: Optional: the names and places spoken in the audio (characters, people, towns), e.g. ["Siobhan", "Tadhg", "Chicoutimi"]. It helps the speech model spell them right. Free: the price does not change. We send up to 100At most 4000 characters of names. List names only: a name that sounds like an ordinary word can replace that word in the transcript ("Noone" for "noon"). If the model refuses the list, you still get the transcript, without it, and result.degraded includes "names".

timestamps.description: Timestamp granularity in result.segments. 'word' returns per-word start/end times (subtitle alignment, karaoke captions, cutting video to speech). Default 'segment'. If the timestamp request fails, you still get the text, and result.degraded includes 'timestamps' (no segments, srt or vtt).

name: transcribe_audio
